candidate_grammar.boundary: Every positive finite single-central coordination support with one or more distinct attached ligand occurrences, tested after seal against all twenty registered IUPAC and NIST definition, structure, value, reference and limitation records.
candidate_grammar.generator: Generate the literal product of carrier, role, identity, attachment, composition, absence, observation and extension forms; decide all 256 forms only from admitted Fold identity, finite incidence, exact composition, source-boundary and successor laws.

excluded_inputs: negative, irrational, imaginary, floating, signed or continuum proof value
imported coordination-number, valence-bond, ligand-field, molecular-orbital or geometry model
observed IUPAC definition or NIST structure record before prediction seal
fitted bond length, selected complex, omitted record or target-derived correction
intended_certificate: Complete 256-form census, one survivor, depth-independent ligand-incidence successor, implementation-distinct reconstruction, capability-closed twenty-record IUPAC/NIST structure vector, complete reported-absence and disclaimer retention, omission, centre-mismatch and numerical-zero controls.
statement: A coordination entity is the complete retained carrier of one central occurrence, every distinct ligand occurrence and every positive central-ligand incidence. Central and surrounding roles are forced by common incidence; repeated ligand labels never erase occurrences, and the next complete ligand preserves every prior identity.
title: Coordination entity and retained central-ligand identity law
